profile.bio: Final-year CS undergraduate building backend systems and applied-ML tools. This CRM is one of them — a portfolio that is also instrumented outreach software. (This is a public demo populated with sample data.)

projects.title: Portfolio CRM
projects.short_description: A portfolio that is also a private outreach CRM.
projects.description: One Django + React system with two faces over a single content store: a public portfolio and a private CRM that runs the outbound campaign driving traffic to it. Leads, a seven-stage pipeline, templated outreach, mail sync and privacy-preserving analytics. (This demo is that CRM, with sample data.)

projects.title: Obsidian RAG Email Sender
projects.short_description: Ask your notes, then draft grounded emails from them.
projects.description: A retrieval-augmented app over an Obsidian vault: chunk and embed notes, retrieve by similarity, and generate answers or emails grounded in the retrieved context with source citations.
